Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: Five bowling balls are lined up touching one another on a smooth surface. Striking the first ball with a hammer makes the fifth ball move away from the group. The force of the hammer was transmitted through the line of balls as what type of wave?
A. electromagnetic
B. heat
C. longitudinal
D. transverse
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
